name: practice
title: Practice
description: A calm clinic theme in soft clinical white with one blue-green accent, oversized type and big tap targets, built around a ruled strip under the masthead that shows opening hours, the phone number and the after-hours emergency line on every page.

tokens.--font-body: all text (system sans — calm and instantly legible)
tokens.--text-s: small text: labels in the strip, meta, footer
tokens.--text-l: ledes, care names, the emergency number, side headings on wide screens
tokens.--text-phone: the main phone number in the strip — the biggest thing on it (it shrinks by itself on narrow phones so a long number still fits)
tokens.--leading-body: body line height (roomy, for tired eyes)
tokens.--color-panel: the strip's background — also code and page-number buttons
tokens.--color-accent: links, the rule on top of the strip, the Call button, focus rings (calm blue-green)
tokens.--color-accent-deep: the phone number, care names, link hover
tokens.--color-on-accent: text placed on the accent color
tokens.--color-border: hairline rules between sections and rows
tokens.--color-emergency: the emergency phone number — the only third color
tokens.--measure: maximum text column width (kept short for easy reading)
tokens.--label-col: width of the left-hand column that holds section headings and care names on wide screens; also the narrowest a part of the strip may get before it wraps
tokens.--radius: corner rounding for buttons and boxes
tokens.--radius-s: small corner rounding: the mark beside the site name, code, focus rings
tokens.--line-bold: thickness of the accent lines: the top of the strip, the current menu item, focus rings, quotes
tokens.--tap-target: minimum touch height for buttons, menu items and phone numbers
